title: KiForge
description: An engineering build pipeline and tool suite for KiCad workflows and PCB design automation. Automates the generation of PCB manufacturing renders, BOMs, SVGs, STEP models, and release artifacts.

title: PhoneScan Companion
description: A React Native Android companion app and USB communication library (@alphaseneca/react-native-phonescan) for the PhoneScan hardware. Connects via USB OTG for live CDC barcode streaming, hardware control, and CH55x ISP firmware flashing.

title: Homelab Infrastructure
description: A self-hosted private cloud and network infrastructure built with Docker, Debian, Raspberry Pi, Cloudflare Tunnels, WireGuard, and Pi-hole for secure remote access and service hosting.

title: Cryptick Token
description: An ESP32-S3-based hardware FIDO2/PIV/OATH security key implementing WebAuthn passkeys, smart-card authentication, and TOTP codes on physical hardware, accompanied by custom KiCad PCB designs and a Rust host daemon.

title: ChronoPixel
description: An addressable LED matrix smart pixel clock and time display featuring custom PCB design, RTC timekeeping, embedded firmware drivers, and customizable illumination patterns.

title: 4x4x4 LED Cube
description: An interactive 3D volumetric LED matrix display with custom multiplexed PCB design, circuit debugging, and embedded C++ animation drivers.
